usedFor: Cloudflare domains are managed with “Create a Zone”, “Create a DNS Record” and “Purge Cached Content”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create a Zone” in Cloudflare
bestTemplate.why: The action adds a new domain as a zone, which an event from another app can start.

watchOut: “Delete a Zone” deletes an existing domain by name, so check the name before it runs.
